notes.subject: יפרש
notes.rationale: 'spreads out' — most read 'spits its venom' (KJV 'stingeth'); literal is the viper shooting out its tongue/venom

notes.subject: joli
notes.rationale: 'venom' supplied: Hebrew says only 'it spreads out', the object implied

notes.subject: צפעני
